title: Git local, remote and push state
summary: Understand branch, upstream, remote-tracking and divergence before integrating or rewriting history.

concepts.title: Local branch
concepts.explanation: A movable ref in the local repository.

concepts.title: Remote-tracking ref
concepts.explanation: The locally recorded view of a remote ref after fetch.

concepts.title: Upstream
concepts.explanation: The branch used by status and pull-related defaults when configured.

concepts.title: Fast-forward
concepts.explanation: An update that advances a ref without discarding commits reachable from its current tip.

limitations: A non-fast-forward rejection does not by itself say whether merge, rebase or guarded history rewrite is appropriate.
Remote-tracking refs can be stale until fetch completes.
